Market today: The mood is cautious, driven by a deepening chip sector sell-off. News of SK Hynix plunging and US/Korean tech links suggest more downside for your concentrated tech/chip book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-49.65%) and SPAL (-56.9%) are bleeding heavily, both leveraged and decaying, with stops that aren't active. QQQ (-4.55%), QQQI (-6.79%), and SMH (-13.8%) are all near their stops. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on your QQQ and QQQI stops. Also, monitor any further weakness in chip names like Nvidia, as this will directly impact your SMH and SOXL.

Bottom line: It's a critical time to manage risk and respect your stops, especially with leveraged positions.
plays: QQQ: Respect your 670 stop. A break below could signal further market weakness.
QQQI: Watch the 52 stop closely. If it breaks, consider exiting to protect capital.
SOXL/SPAL: Re-evaluate your stops for these leveraged ETFs. Their current default stops are not protecting your significant losses.
